structure: A two-column question table. The confirmation question's answer cell prints BLUE author guidance in its first paragraph and leaves an empty paragraph below it for the answer (MAPPA-like). A second row is an ordinary empty date cell.
authored_from: build_forms.py intent (f1_guidance_confirmation), written before any engine run on this form
slot_grammar: neutral v3 ground-truth grammar; see check_expected.py

areas.label: Does a formal offender supervision scheme currently apply to this person?
areas.cardinality: one value (a yes/no confirmation, with level, category and agency confirmation when yes)

destination.description: table 0, row 0, cell 1 (right column): the EMPTY paragraph p[1] BELOW the blue guidance paragraph p[0]. The answer is written there; the guidance stays exactly as printed.

preserve.b/tbl[0]/tr[0]/tc[1]/p[0]: State yes or no. If yes, give the management level and category, and confirm that the lead agency knows this report is being written.

areas.repair_note: 2026-09-29 repair (CHECK.md) W1: the printed question was reworded with fresh wording (the first wording shared two short phrases with a development label); must_name follows the new printed words. Kind, destination, guidance and cardinality are unchanged.
areas.guidance: The blue text is author guidance for the person answering: it describes what the answer must contain (yes/no; if yes, level, category and lead-agency confirmation). It is NOT an answer, NOT a prefilled value and must never be deleted or overwritten.

areas.label: Date the lead agency was last informed

destination.description: table 0, row 1, cell 1 (right column): an empty cell

areas.repair_note: 2026-09-29 repair (CHECK.md) M3: must_not_name carries the OTHER question's guidance words, so a label that absorbed the neighbouring blue guidance (the known defect) grades wrong; 'lead agency' alone also occurs inside that guidance and could not tell the two labels apart.

controls.printed: State yes or no. If yes, give the management level and category, and confirm that the lead agency knows this report is being written.
controls.reason: Printed guidance for the answering clinician. Mapping it as an answer destination, or replacing it (cell_replace), destroys form instructions the recipient relies on; the answer belongs below it (f1.A1).
A heading names the section; it has no answer area.

extras_policy: Any other answerable field (for example on the trailing empty body paragraph b/p[1]) is a false field.
